lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of large, high-luminance circular spots are arranged in a sparse, roughly linear horizontal formation posterior to the gill slits, with a prominent cluster of three spots forming an obtuse triangle above the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to create a subtle grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of small, high-intensity spots that transition from a cluttered arrangement at the leading edge to a more ordered, linear distribution toward the trailing edge.
